about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_pairs.py). bad replays the ambiguous edit of the failure class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real Found-multiple-matches line. good re-reads wider and lands the same case: it writes the file and prints the unique-match report it promises.

fixture.target.txt:
line one
{
card alpha
status open
}
{
card beta
status open
}
## Notes
alpha body here
## Notes
beta body here
board | K-01 | guard PASS
board | K-02 | guard PASS
import os
context A line
import os
note repeated twice
wider line one
note repeated twice

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::IndexOf($ls, '{'); $ls[$i] = '{ # alpha block'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'brace unique diff PASS alpha anchored'

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::IndexOf($ls, 'card alpha') + 1; $ls[$i] = 'status closed'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'status unique diff PASS card alpha closed'

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::IndexOf($ls, 'board | K-01 | guard PASS'); $ls[$i] = 'board | K-01 | guard DONE'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'board unique diff PASS K-01 row id'

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::LastIndexOf($ls, '## Notes'); $ls[$i] = '## Notes beta'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'heading unique diff PASS beta section'

pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::LastIndexOf($ls, 'import os'); $ls[$i] = 'import os # second block'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'import unique diff PASS second block'

pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::IndexOf($ls, 'note repeated twice'); $ls[$i] = 'note fixed once'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'sentence unique diff PASS wider lines'

pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $i = [Array]::IndexOf($ls, 'board | K-02 | guard PASS'); $ls[$i] = 'board | K-02 | guard DONE'; Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Value $ls; 'unique reread diff PASS K-02 wider'

pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern 'status open' -Path target.txt).Count; $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'status open','status closed' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; "replaceAll verified count PASS count $c"

pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern 'status open' -Path target.txt).Count; if ($c -gt 1) { "count refuse verified PASS matches $c refused single edit" } else { throw 'unexpected single match' }
